Two Sum Arrays Uber Salesforce Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the indices of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`. You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution. 2 <= nums.length <= 10^5
-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9 Level 1: Try checking target - nums[i] complement. Level 2: Use a hash map to search complement values in O(1) time. Level 3: Store elements and their indices while scanning. Level 4: FOR i from 0 to N:
  comp = target - nums[i]
  IF comp in map return [map[comp], i]
  map[nums[i]] = i Level 5: Verify with negative values in the array.

Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock Arrays Google Salesforce Intel You are given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a given stock on the `i`-th day. You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and choosing a different day in the future to sell that stock. 1 <= prices.length <= 10^5
0 <= prices[i] <= 10^4 Level 1: Track the minimum price seen so far. Level 2: Calculate potential profit at each day. Level 3: Keep the maximum profit. Level 4: FOR price in prices:
  min_price = min(min_price, price)
  max_profit = max(max_profit, price - min_price) Level 5: Check edge cases with strictly decreasing prices.
